The revised v6 Lemma 8.3 upper-order monotonicity is proved for mapped finite-completion coefficients; carrier equality is proved from lower Corollary 6.3, upper monotone-order diagonalization, and an explicit transport of the lower basis lattice to the separately realized upper good-BONG lattice; this last identification is not yet established

For the literal scalar extension of a specified dyadic lattice, the carrier is proved equal to the upper valuation-ring span of pure tensors. At actual finite number-field completions, the completed embedding preserves the valuation ring and any integral basis is carried to its base-changed integral basis. This supplies the basis transport for the literal scalar-extension lattice, but does not identify the separately realized upper good-BONG lattice with it

Lemma 8.1(i)-(ii) are proved for actual dyadic local-field structures on the selected finite completions: the continuous finite-dimensional extension is constructed, order scaling holds for every nonzero completed-base-field element, relative quadratic-defect scaling is proved from mapped square approximations, and the completion order, defect, and ramification normalizations are identified with the BONG notions. The exact He--Hu adjacent and two-step coefficient criterion is preserved, and every actual lower good BONG has an actual upper integral-lattice good-BONG realization with precisely the mapped values. This realizes the existential lattice conclusion newly stated in v6 Lemma 8.1(iii) in a standard diagonal ambient space; the concrete isometry to the literal scalar-extension ambient and the separate carrier identification now used in v6 Lemma 8.3 remain to be formalized. Proposition 8.2, the global deduction in Theorem 1.5, and Theorem 1.9 are proved conditionally from explicit number-field arithmetic proof-data packages; Proposition 8.2 is derived from positive-definite globalization, localization of integrality and representation, and local-equivalence transport rather than assumed as a final field; Theorem 1.9's finite-place conclusion is derived from separate non-dyadic, dyadic unary, and dyadic higher-rank laws, and its local-to-global step is derived target-by-target from rank and integrality localization plus an explicit strong-approximation representation law; the number-field discriminant/ramification equivalence, both directed uses, the ramified dyadic-prime witness, and positivity are proved; canonical number-field global data defines the dyadic predicate, ramification index, and discriminant proposition from the standard height-one spectrum and derives all arithmetic compatibility fields from a place equivalence; Lemma 8.3, Theorem 1.7, and Theorem 1.8 have only n >= 2 even source-facing endpoints, while Theorem 1.7's rank-independent final contradiction is separately proved from an explicit local-defect premise; no unrestricted odd endpoint is exported; reports 23 and 27-44

reviewNotice: The semantic basis is the user-approved author-corrected v6 TeX manuscript identified by filename and SHA-256; it is not redistributed. Report 44 maps every mathematically material v5-to-v6 change, and Report 45 records the new literal scalar-extension lattice results. The local Theorem 1.1 and Theorem 1.3 endpoints retain their checked v5 proofs because their v6 statements did not change; Corollary 6.3 and the affected Section 8 statements now explicitly assume even n >= 2, matching the existing Lean endpoint hypotheses. Lemma 8.1(i)-(ii) are proved on actual dyadic completions. The current upper good-BONG realization proves the v6 part-(iii) existential coefficient/lattice result in a standard diagonal ambient. The specified scalar-extension lattice is now independently proved to be the pure-tensor valuation-ring span and to carry every base-changed lower integral basis at finite completions, but the isometry and lattice identification joining that object to the separately realized upper good-BONG lattice have not yet been formalized. The revised v6 Lemma 8.3 local obstruction remains conditional. Global Theorem 1.5, Proposition 8.2, and Theorems 1.7-1.9 still require concrete localization, arithmetic, and approximation instances. The e=2, n=3 counterexample refutes only the obsolete unrestricted v5 Corollary 6.3. Historical v5 Review Kit Report 43 does not certify this v6 source sync. Grade D / NOT_COMPLETE remains; no v6 GitHub CI, independent merged-commit Review Kit, release, or human semantic sign-off is yet claimed.
